prompt: Where does a military-purposed UAV that isn't described on the USML classify now?
assertions: States the August 2026 change: BIS reversed its 2013 ECR position — such UAVs now classify in 9A610.a (with MT language mirroring 9A012)
Notes less-sensitive parts/components/accessories go to new 9A610.y.33
Mentions license exception STA availability to Country Group A:5 where the UAV cannot deliver ≥500 kg payload to ≥300 km (§740.20(g) conditions)
Applies the order of review: USML Category VIII first (CJ if unclear), then CCL
Notes 3A611.a no longer applies to these UAVs after the rule
